form:FormGroup.label: Selector
form:FormGroup.helpText: The expression a stream's metadata, receipt headers and record shape signature must match for this rule to bind. Rules are tried in table order; the first match wins.

form:FormGroup.label: Fragment
form:FormGroup.helpText: The pipeline fragment to route matching streams to: a pipeline that starts at Source and ends before any destination. Leave empty to reserve the selector: a matching shape is given up rather than learned.

form:FormGroup.label: Pinned
form:FormGroup.helpText: A pinned rule keeps its fragment; promotion will not rebind it.
